test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The diameter of an iron ball used for shot-put is 21 cm. It is melted and then a cylinder of height 3.5 cm is made. The curved surface area of the cylinder will be: (Use pi = 22over7)
solution:
**Given:**

The diameter of an iron ball used for shot-put = 21 cm

Height of a cylinder = 3.5 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of cylinder = πr²h

Volume of the sphere = 4/3 πr³

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh

**Calculation:**

The radius of an iron ball = 21/2 = 10.5

Volume of the ball = (4/3 × 22/7 × 10.5 × 10.5 × 10.5)

⇒ (4 × 22 × 0.5 × 10.5 × 10.5)

⇒ 4,851

Volume of solid cylinder = Volume of the ball

⇒ πr²h = 4,851

⇒ 22/7 × r² × 3.5 = 4,851

⇒ 11r² = 4851

⇒ r² = 4851/11

⇒ r² = 441

⇒ r = 21 cm

Now

Curved surface area of cylinder = (2 × 22/7 × 21 × 3.5) cm²

⇒ (2 × 22 × 3 × 3.5) cm²

⇒ 462 cm²

**∴ The curved surface area of the cylinder will be 462 cm²**
